facts.fact: URA says the NIN-to-TIN initiative links national identity to tax administration to strengthen taxpayer authentication and verification, rolled out in phases to January 2027.

facts.fact: URA says a TIN is a 10-digit unique number it allocates and issues free of charge to identify a person as a registered taxpayer in Uganda.
URA says that for non-individuals (company, trust, partnership) the number used for tax is the registration number issued by the Uganda Registration Services Bureau.
URA says Cabinet approved on 31 August 2026 the use of the NIN as the TIN for individual taxpayers, after the Tax Procedures Code Act s.4 amendment in FY 2025/26 mandated it.
